replace:
-- [AnimePlayer: right-click chapter] right-click on the progress bar jumps to the chapter under the mouse pointer
		-- (the last chapter that starts at or before that point; without chapters it seeks to the pointer position). A custom
		-- `timeline_mbtn_right` command in uosc.conf still wins when it is set.
		cursor:zone('secondary_down', self, function()
			if #options.timeline_mbtn_right > 0 then self:cursor_command(options.timeline_mbtn_right) return end
			if not (state.time and state.duration) then return end
			local t = self:get_time_at_x(cursor.x)
			local target = nil
			for _, chapter in ipairs(state.chapters or {}) do
				if chapter.time <= t + 0.05 and (not target or chapter.time > target) then target = chapter.time end
			end
			if #(state.chapters or {}) > 0 and not target then target = 0 end
			mp.commandv('seek', target or t, 'absolute+exact')
		end)
